0022600183.text: The Trail Blazers, 5-1 and first in the Northwest, are 4-0 on the road and have won two straight, while the Phoenix Suns (1-3, 12th in the West) have lost two straight and are playing their fourth game of the season. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), while Jordan Goodwin is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision. Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 124-83 win in Portland on October 21, 2026, and the Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
